subject.title: Feature Request: Memory Trust Tagging by Source

question: What native memory trust/provenance contract should OpenClaw implement across memory-core, QMD, Active Memory, session-memory, Memory Wiki/MCP bridge, and SDK/config surfaces?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the data model, trust assignment source, review/expiration behavior, retrieval weighting, config/API exposure, and plugin boundaries require product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Design native trust contract first
options.body: Define the canonical trust/provenance schema and policy semantics before changing storage, retrieval, SDK, and docs surfaces.

options.title: Fold into provenance MVP first
options.body: Treat #42647 and #48519 as prerequisites, then implement this item as the memory-policy layer on top of that provenance model.

options.title: Defer native enforcement to external memory plugins
options.body: Document MCP/plugin workarounds such as world-model-mcp and leave default OpenClaw memory without native trust enforcement for now.

recommendation.title: Design native trust contract first
recommendation.body: Define the canonical trust/provenance schema and policy semantics before changing storage, retrieval, SDK, and docs surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: This person shows the strongest overlap with the current memory host SDK, memory-core seams, and prior maintainer-style review of the item.
